title: Sort paginated sitemaps by _id for stable pages and enable 24-hour Worker edge caching for all sitemaps

endpoints.before: Paginated offer sitemap pages sorted by lastModifiedDate descending (shifting all pages whenever an offer updated) and bypassed the Worker edge cache.
endpoints.after: Paginated offer sitemap pages sort by _id ascending for append-only stable page assignments, and GET/HEAD responses are cached at the Cloudflare Worker edge for 24 hours (86400s).

endpoints.before: Paginated item sitemap pages sorted by lastModifiedDate descending and bypassed the Worker edge cache.
endpoints.after: Paginated item sitemap pages sort by _id ascending for stable page assignments, and GET/HEAD responses are cached at the Cloudflare Worker edge for 24 hours (86400s).

endpoints.before: Paginated item sitemap pages sorted by lastModifiedDate descending and bypassed the Worker edge cache.
endpoints.after: Paginated item sitemap pages sort by _id ascending for stable page assignments, and GET/HEAD responses are cached at the Cloudflare Worker edge for 24 hours (86400s).

endpoints.before: Paginated sandbox sitemap pages sorted by lastModified descending, emitted no Cache-Control header, and bypassed the Worker edge cache.
endpoints.after: Paginated sandbox sitemap pages sort by _id ascending for stable page assignments and are cached at the Cloudflare Worker edge with a 24-hour (86400s) TTL.

endpoints.before: Bypassed the Cloudflare Worker edge cache on every request.
endpoints.after: GET/HEAD responses are cached at the Cloudflare Worker edge for 24 hours (86400s).

endpoints.before: Emitted no Cache-Control header and bypassed the Cloudflare Worker edge cache on every request.

endpoints.after: Paginated offer sitemap pages sort by _id ascending for append-only stable page assignments and use a 24-hour (86400s) Worker edge cache TTL.
